overloads.semanticRole: The PLAY command plays sound or multimedia files.

constraints: On macOS, sound is always played asynchronously regardless of whether async is passed.
The async parameter only affects behavior on Windows: if passed with 0 (or any longint value) playback is asynchronous, otherwise playback is synchronous by default.
Passing an empty string in objectName stops an asynchronous sound currently playing.
On macOS, objectName can also name a system sound instead of a file path.
